big_case.notes: Private Sherman Act dispute over Brown Shoe submarket definition between a medical-supply relabeler and a group purchasing organization; Fifth Circuit summary-judgment affirmance; respondent waived, one solo-practitioner amicus, denied on first conference without noted dissent. Doctrinally recurring question but low institutional stakes.
